qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Prudential operates a large tied-agency force and bancassurance distribution across Asia, but life and health policies lack pricing power over inflation and face intense competition from AIA, Manulife, HSBC, and domestic insurers. Multi-cycle GAAP returns on capital/equity are volatile and average well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Pan-Asian life and health insurer operating in commoditized protection and savings markets with no pricing power over inflation. Multi-cycle GAAP returns on capital/equity average well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROE is sub-10% (negative in 2021 and 2022). Following the demergers of UK (M&G) and US (Jackson) operations, the business is concentrated in Greater China and Southeast Asia where policies are sold via price-sensitive agency and bancassurance channels without pricing power.
